# NEW 2026-11-18 fourth round D1 (tributary ladder and buying peace). Generated by gen_round4_tributary.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Imperial Authority is at least 50 (suzerainty is gained).
oe_ttb_auth_high = {
    exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority var:oe_pillars_authority >= 50 }
}
# Any scope. Imperial Authority is below 40, or the Pillars are gone (suzerainty is lost; the AI may buy peace).
oe_ttb_auth_low = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority } }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority var:oe_pillars_authority < 40 }
    }
}
# Country scope. A tributary (vanilla type) of Byzantium.
oe_ttb_is_trib = {
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    is_subject_type = tributary
    is_subject_of = c:BYZ
}
# Country scope. A tributary that may rise to the Roman alliance now (event oe_ttb.2).
oe_ttb_promote_ready = {
    oe_ttb_is_trib = yes
    has_variable = oe_ttb_months
    var:oe_ttb_months >= 120
    opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 50 }
    OR = { oe_tw_eastern_church = yes oe_tw_rw_member = yes }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_wait }
}
# Country scope. A country Byzantium may offer tribute for peace: a real country, not its subject or overlord, with a
# larger army, that borders Byzantium (or lies one sea zone away) or is at war with it, and has no agreement yet.
# Themes own no land (their jurisdiction is Byzantine land), so bordering a theme is bordering Byzantium.
oe_ttb_peace_target_ok = {
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
    country_type = location
    army_size > oe_ttb_byz_army
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace }
    NOT = { is_subject_or_below_of = c:BYZ }
    save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ttb_pt
    NOT = { c:BYZ = { is_subject_or_below_of = scope:oe_ttb_pt } }
    OR = {
        is_at_war_with = c:BYZ
        is_neighbor_of_country_or_across_one_seazone = c:BYZ
    }
}
# Country scope. At war with Byzantium and winning at least one of those wars (its side's war score >= 5).
oe_ttb_winning_vs_byz = {
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    is_at_war_with = c:BYZ
    save_temporary_scope_as = oe_ttb_wt
    any_current_war = {
        is_on_opposite_sides = { country = c:BYZ target = scope:oe_ttb_wt }
        scope:oe_ttb_wt = { war_score_in_war_whole_side = { war = prev value >= 5 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. May send an envoy with tribute now (the action's allow, the AI and the worker event).
oe_ttb_can_offer = {
    tag = BYZ
    # r13 (2026-11-19): was NOT = { has_variable var >= MAX }, which read the unset counter and, as NOR, refused a
    # second agreement once the counter existed.
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_ttb_allow_count OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_peace_n } var:oe_ttb_peace_n < 3 } }
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_ttb_allow_gold gold >= oe_ttb_peace_amount }
}
# BYZ scope. Has at least one agreement (the stop action's allow).
oe_ttb_has_peace = {
    tag = BYZ
    custom_tooltip = { text = oe_ttb_allow_any has_variable = oe_ttb_peace_n var:oe_ttb_peace_n >= 1 }
}
# Country scope. AI Byzantium buys peace from this neighbour: more than 2 times its army, no truce, no recent
# refusal, not winning a war against Byzantium.
oe_ttb_ai_target = {
    army_size > oe_ttb_byz_army_ai
    oe_ttb_peace_target_ok = yes
    is_neighbor_of_country_or_across_one_seazone = c:BYZ
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_refused }
    NOT = { has_truce_with = c:BYZ }
    NOT = { oe_ttb_winning_vs_byz = yes }
}
# BYZ scope. The AI insurance applies (docstring item 9): Byzantium is AI-run, or a test button set oe_ttb_ai_test.
oe_ttb_ai_rules = {
    OR = {
        is_ai = yes
        has_variable = oe_ttb_ai_test
    }
}
# Country scope (a payee). The AI insurance may hold back its payment: any agreement except the vassal tribute to the
# Ottomans while the vassal-sultan line runs (BYZ var oe_vas_stage, gen_vassal_andronikos.py), which keeps that line's
# own rules (paid, or broken and answered with the sultan's patience).
oe_ttb_ai_holdable = {
    NOT = {
        AND = {
            tag = TUR
            country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_vas_stage }
        }
    }
}
# Country scope. Test only: a neighbour that can be made a tributary by the dev button.
oe_ttb_test_make_ok = {
    country_exists = c:BYZ
    NOT = { tag = BYZ }
    country_type = location
    is_subject = no
    NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ }
    is_neighbor_of_country_or_across_one_seazone = c:BYZ
}
